lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke wakes up in a cold sweat. He's had the nightmare again.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Professor... I had that dream again. The one about... shopping.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Ah, Luke. Shopping is nothing to fear, my boy.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: But Professor, I've never done it by myself before!

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Well, today is the day. I'm afraid you must go to Grocery Outlet alone.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: What?! No! Why can't you come with me?

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: I have... important business. Besides, this will be a valuable learning experience.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I... I don't know if I can do this.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Luke, do you remember the first time I went shopping? I was terrified too.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Indeed. But I learned something important that day. Sometimes, the things we fear most are the things we must face.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Try turning on the radio, Luke. Music often helps with nervousness.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Okay... I'll try anything at this point.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke turns on the radio. Bubsy's theme starts playing.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I feel... better already? I think?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The music fades as we cut to outside...
